block.$description: Height of the skeleton block, a placeholder for an image or a chart.

circle.$description: Skeleton circle diameter, a placeholder for an avatar.

gap.$description: Gap between the label and the value.

count-gap.$description: Gap between tab label and count. Source used 6px; rounded to 8 to hold the 4px grid.

count-padding-h.$description: Tab: left and right padding of the count. 0 on mobile.

count-padding-v.$description: Tab: top and bottom padding of the count. 0 on mobile.

body-gap.$description: Toast: gap between the title and the meta line. 0 on mobile.

gap.$description: Gap between toast icon and body. Source used 14px.

inset-h.$description: Horizontal knob inset. 1.5px border + the source's 2px offset, CSS positions the knob from the padding edge, so the true offset from the outer edge is 3.5px.

inset-v.$description: Vertical knob inset. The knob is centred, so this only sets the minimum breathing room.

knob.$description: Toggle knob diameter, inset 2px from the track.

arrow-overlap.$description: Tooltip: how far the arrow overlaps the bubble. 0 on mobile.

focus.$description: Follows the Context mode: focus, or inverse-outline.

logo.$description: Logo colour. Dark on a light page and light on a dark one, so it never disappears.

logo-glyph.$description: The glyph inside the compact logo mark. Always the opposite of ctx/logo.

on-primary.$description: Follows the Context mode: on-primary, or inverse-on-primary.

on-surface.$description: Follows the Context mode: on-surface, or inverse-on-surface.

on-surface-variant.$description: Follows the Context mode: on-surface-variant, or inverse-on-surface-variant.

outline.$description: Follows the Context mode: outline, or inverse-outline.

outline-variant.$description: Follows the Context mode: outline-variant, or inverse-outline-variant.

primary.$description: Follows the Context mode: primary, or inverse-primary.

primary-hover.$description: Follows the Context mode: primary-hover, or inverse-primary-hover.

primary-pressed.$description: Follows the Context mode: primary-pressed, or inverse-primary-pressed.

surface.$description: Follows the Context mode: surface, or inverse-surface on an inverted band.

surface-container.$description: Follows the Context mode: surface-container, or inverse-surface.

field.$description: Form field border. Neither hairline (1px) nor button (2px), the field preview specifies 1.5px and it had no token.

focus.$description: Weight of the keyboard focus ring.

body.$description: Font size of Body/Default, Body/Default Semi-Bold.

body-sm.$description: Dense-UI text, tables, meta rows, chips. 43 hardcoded uses in the source CSS; legitimised as a role.

button.$description: 17px desktop / 16px mobile. The mobile value comes from .btn in extended-components.css.

caption.$description: Smallest supported size. Only 3 uses in source, weakest case in the scale, drop if it stays unused.

h1.$description: H1 size: the one title of a page.

h3.$description: H3 size: a section title inside a page.

h4.$description: Fills the gap between H3 (20) and H2 (40). The source used 22, 24 and 26 across empty states, accordions and modals, all drift around the same missing role.

h5.$description: H5 size: small section headings inside cards, alerts and panels.

h6.$description: H6 size: the title of a card, a list group or a form section.

h7.$description: H7 size: the smallest heading, above a short block of text.

stat.$description: Metric value. 44px desktop / 36px mobile. Sits between H2 (40) and Display (56); the source used 44 with -4% tracking, the tightest in the system.

columns.$description: Gap between the columns of the grid.

card.$description: Nested card corner. Concentric with radius/container: an inner corner should be the outer radius minus the inset, so 20 outer with a 4px inset gives 16. Use this for any card sitting inside a container, and radius/container for the outermost surface.

field.$description: Form fields only, the quiet middle ground.

none.$description: SIGNATURE, the button radius. Sharp corners against 20px cards is the brand fingerprint. Do not round.

surface.$description: Overlay and notification corner, menus, popovers, alerts, toasts. Between radius/field (4) and radius/container (20).

col-1.$description: Reading column in a one-column layout: narrower than the container on purpose. One container wide on mobile. Proposal, to confirm.

col-2.$description: Width of one column in a two-column layout: six of the twelve grid columns. One container wide on mobile.

col-3.$description: Width of one column in a three-column layout: four of the twelve grid columns. One container wide on mobile.

col-4.$description: Width of one column in a four-column layout: three of the twelve grid columns. Was 268, which did not add up to the container. One container wide on mobile. Proposal, to confirm.

col-5.$description: Width of one column in a five-column layout. Was 206, which did not add up to the container. Five does not sit on the twelve-column grid: prefer four or six. One container wide on mobile. Proposal, to confirm.

col-6.$description: Width of one column in a six-column layout: two of the twelve grid columns. One container wide on mobile.

container.$description: Width of the page container. 264 on mobile.

control.$description: Checkbox box and radio ring. Fixed geometry, does not scale with breakpoint.

full-width.$description: Full width of the page. 360 on mobile.

icon-sm.$description: Small UI icon, for dense rows.

2xs.$description: Gap between related items inside a card. 12 on mobile.

3xs.$description: Tight pairs, such as a label and its field.

control-gap.$description: Gap between a control and its label. Sits between space/3xs (8) and space/2xs (16), the source uses 10px and it had no token.

lg.$description: Largest section padding. Non-linear jump from md, intentional.

md.$description: Gap between sections of a page. 48 on mobile.

sm.$description: Gap between blocks inside a section. 32 on mobile.

xs.$description: Padding inside a card. 24 on mobile.

inverse-outline-variant.$description: Dividers and quiet borders on inverse-surface.

inverse-surface.$description: A surface that is the opposite of the page: dark bands, toasts, tooltips.

on-surface-success.$description: Success text, icons and borders on any surface. Tone 40 in Light, 80 in Dark, AA on every surface.

on-warning-container.$description: Text and icons on a warning container.

outline.$description: Strong borders: fields, outline buttons, selected controls.

outline-medium.$description: Medium borders: a search field at rest, drop zones, media placeholders and the empty-state ring. At least 3:1 on every surface where they sit.

primary.$description: The main action: Solid button fill, links, selected controls.

success.$description: Solid success fill: the same strong colour in Light and Dark, with on-success (white) on top. For success text on a surface use on-surface-success.

surface.$description: Page background. The base every other surface sits on.

surface-container.$description: Cards, dialogs, panels and fields. One step up from the page.

surface-container-high.$description: Menus, popovers and the hover of a row or card.

surface-container-highest.$description: Highest container: skeleton blocks and tracks.

surface-container-low.$description: Quiet areas inside a page: rails, table headers, grouped rows.

surface-hover.$description: An unselected control or neutral element under the pointer.

surface-pressed.$description: An unselected control or neutral element while pressed.

transparent.$description: No fill. Outline and Ghost buttons at rest. 0% alpha because Figma has no transparent keyword.

warning.$description: Solid warning fill: the same strong colour in Light and Dark, with on-warning (white) on top. For warning text on a surface use on-surface-warning.
